title: Camp Cagg
wikitext:
[[File:Camp Cagg.jpg|thumb|300px|Camp Cagg]]

'''Camp Cagg''' is, together with [[Camp Boff]], [[Camp Kosh|Kosh]] and [[Camp Wurg|Wurg]], the home of some of the [[Dustbelcher]] [[ogre]]s. One exception though was their leader, [[Boss Tho'grun]], who patrolled the [[Badlands]] between the four ogre bases.
